name: Batman Signal
look: A blue-tinted night sky with clouds. A searchlight beam throws a blank oval of light onto the clouds at upper left, while Batman stands in silhouette atop a ledge of a dark building on the right, cape hanging.
use: Summoning the one person who always answers a certain call. Something is placed in the empty light where the bat logo would be, and Batman is labeled as whoever comes running when that thing appears.
slots: the summoning symbol or words, in the blank spotlight (top left)
who answers the call (Batman silhouette, right)
examples: Free pizza in the break room
Someone says "quick question" in the group chat
describe: bat signal in the sky with batman watching
spotlight shining an empty circle on the clouds at night
batman silhouette on a rooftop looking at the signal
blue night sky with a blank searchlight oval
dark knight standing on a building with a light in the clouds
